name: Carrom
description: A tactile carrom table built to the International Carrom Federation board: a 74 cm surface, 4.45 cm pockets, baseline strips with red base circles, diagonal foul lines, and a tight 19-piece medallion. Deterministic pocket physics, local pass-and-play, a simulation-backed AI opponent, and server-owned online tables for two, three, or four players with spectators and table chat.
tagline: Flick, bank, and pocket your way to the queen.
